carla_cust: Hi team — we're seeing intermittent failures when provisioning new keys into our CloudHSM cluster. Jobs hang on "attach key" step and then timeout after ~45s. This started after a maintenance window.

alice_support: Sorry to hear that, carla. Can you paste the error payload or the agent logs for one failed attempt? Also do you know if this is only for imports or all operations?

carla_cust: Only imports so far (key provisioning). Other ops like encrypt/decrypt are mostly OK but signing sometimes times out. Error from our side: `ERROR: hsm_attach_timeout: failed to complete attach after 45000ms`

carla_cust: From the CloudHSM client log around the time: ```[2026-02-23T15:12:41Z] mgmt: allocate_session failed: PKCS11_CKR_SESSION_COUNT (alloc sessions reached) [2026-02-23T15:12:42Z] crypto: import_key failed: HSM_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY```

ben_prodops: That mgmt log smells like session exhaustion to me. What does `session_count` look like on the cluster? Can you run the HSM client status: ```cloudhsm-cli status --format json``` and paste output?

carla_cust: Ran it, here's a redacted snippet: ```{"clusterId":"c-abc123","activeSessions":256,"maxSessions":256,"queuedOps":18}``` — looks like we're pegged at the session cap.

alice_support: Thanks — that confirms session pool saturation. Two immediate causes: (1) clients not closing sessions quickly (leak), or (2) a sudden spike in parallel imports. Do you use a connection pool or single process doing retries?

carla_cust: We use a worker fleet that parallelizes imports (we scaled up after maintenance). Each worker opens a session per import and sometimes retries on timeout. Might be retry amplification.

dave_eng_crypto: Looping in eng-crypto. @carla_cust — retry amplification is common here. Two suggestions to test: (A) temporarily throttle import concurrency down to 8 parallel jobs; (B) add expedited session close on error paths (ensure PKCS11 C_CloseSession is called). Also can you collect client debug logs during repro? Use: ```export PKCS11_DEBUG=1 && ./import_tool --key-file /tmp/test.key --verbose```

carla_cust: Doing a quick test: throttled to 8 concurrent imports and observed success for 30 runs in a row. When increased back to 32, failures resumed and attach timeouts returned.

erin_security: From a security/compliance angle — please note any imports that failed might not have corresponding audit entries in the HSM's audit stream. We need to capture potential gaps for retention/audit purposes. Can you provide the timestamps for failed imports so we can cross-check HSM audit logs?

carla_cust: Failed window: 2026-02-23T15:10:30Z -> 2026-02-23T15:16:00Z. Example failed job id: job-7892.

hsm_bot: Automated note: new HSM alert triggered c-abc123: activeSessions==maxSessions at 2026-02-23T15:12:39Z (rule: session-ceiling).

alice_support: Filing internal escalation and tracking. Initial triage: session exhaustion causing attach timeouts. Next steps: (1) config change on customer side to limit concurrency, (2) engineering follow-up to improve client's session reuse and safe retry backoff, (3) compare audit stream for gaps and capture any missing event IDs.

dave_eng_crypto: I'll take ownership of the eng follow-up. Quick repro steps I'm going to run against a staging cluster: 1) spike parallel import workers to 48; 2) run import workload that intentionally sleeps while holding session; 3) observe session allocation + queuedOps metrics. Hypothesis: import path holds sessions across IO/retries.

dave_eng_crypto: For mitigation we can (a) add short-lived in-memory session pooling that reuses sessions across imports, (b) implement exponential backoff with jitter before retries to avoid thundering herd, (c) add diagnostic logs that emit session handle counts per import call.

alice_support: @erin_security please confirm if we should trigger a compliance review for possible audit retention gaps for customer carla_cust. If yes, we'll need to capture raw audit segments for the window and deliver to legal/compliance.

erin_security: Yes please capture the raw audit stream for 2026-02-23T15:08:00Z -> 2026-02-23T15:20:00Z. If we see missing entries for job-7892 or others, escalate to the compliance bucket and notify the customer success manager.

ben_prodops: Action items for ops: (1) increase maxSessions on cluster c-abc123 as a short-term relief if capacity available, (2) throttle inbound import traffic via edge rate limiter, (3) schedule a rolling restart of HSM client daemons if session counts don't drop after retry throttling.

carla_cust: Appreciate the quick responses. Please keep me posted. We'll keep imports at 8 concurrency for now. If you need any more logs I can forward them.

alice_support: Assigned ticket S-123456 to eng-crypto (dave_eng_crypto). We'll update here when we have audit confirmation and proposed code changes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

carla_cust: Thanks all — for traceability, here's the full failed request payload (redacted): ```{"jobId":"job-7892","attempt":3,"error":"hsm_attach_timeout","ts":"2026-02-23T15:12:44Z"}``` 

dave_eng_crypto: Got it. I'll post a short postmortem draft once we reproduce and fix. Meanwhile we'll collect the audit blobs.

alice_support: Closing the operational loop in this thread — leave it open until we have audit confirmation and a patch plan.
